messages:
mike: Packing is ready for private/vpc build `v2.14.0-rc1`. Installer + sealed OCI bundle uploaded to staging storage. Need final KMS handoff and deploybot window.

jen: copying. Which signer will cosign? pkg_signer? we need timestamps + manifest tag pinned.

pkg_signer: I can sign. Please confirm the exact manifest tag and the KMS key alias to use. Also need the release notes blurb.

mike: manifest tag `sealed-installer:v2.14.0-rc1-20260321`. KMS alias `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/release/cryptoKeys/installer-sign`. Release notes: short: "private/vpc installer: on-prem airgap bundle, KMS-signed, improved delta apply and CVE mitigations (libtls)."

pkg_signer: ACK. I'll cosign and push signature to `s3://redwood-staging/airgap/v2.14.0-rc1/signature.json` after handoff. ETA ~ 18:20 UTC.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy requested by <@mike>. Canary window: 23:00-23:30 UTC. Canary targets: 3 reserved customer VPCs (canary-1/2/3). If >=2/3 pass health and checksum verification, proceed to staged fanout. Fallback: instant rollback to `v2.13.7` if failures exceed threshold.

ops_ryan: FYI I'll be on-call for the window and watching rollout metrics (latency, error-rate, disk space). If canary errors > 3% 5m-avg, hold and escalate.

sre_aly: Add metric: installer preflight checksum failures per host. If >1% abort.

jen: Do we have checksum validation docs for the offline transport? I want the exact command so support can triage.

maria-support: put me on the thread. we need the `sha256` of the sealed bundle and cosign key id to show to clients.

mike: sha256: `3a7f9b2d...f4c1` (truncated in chat). Full checksum in staging manifest. cosign key id: `projects/release/keys/installer-signer-v3`.

pkg_signer: cosign command I will run:

```
cosign sign --key gcpkms://projects/release/locations/global/keyRings/release/cryptoKeys/installer-sign 
  gcr.io/redwood/sealed-installer:v2.14.0-rc1-20260321
```

After sign I'll post the `sig` and `sig_bundle` to the staging path.

deploy-bot: deploybot note: ensure `transport-checksum` prehook is enabled for private flows. See config `deploybot/hooks/private_transport.yaml`.

mike: Also note: packaging added a new delta apply mode that changes install order. There's a short note in release notes and a migration flag `--legacy-apply` for rollback paths.

jen: Good. Add explicit rollback steps to release notes:
- If installer fails during delta-apply on host group, re-run with `--legacy-apply` then contact ops.
- For widespread checksum mismatches, instruct teams to fetch `sealed-installer:v2.13.7` and re-deploy.

maria-support: copying that into the customer-facing KB.

ops_ryan: Quick checklist for canary: (1) cosign present and verified, (2) md5/sha256 match on each host, (3) preflight hook exit code 0, (4) health-check endpoints 200 for 5m.

sre_aly: Also verify KV cache compatibility for model-serving path — this release touches runtime packaging that affected cache layout in prior RCs. Canary should exercise short prompt path.

pkg_signer: Signed and uploaded. Signature path: `s3://redwood-staging/airgap/v2.14.0-rc1/signature.json`. cosign output:
```
Created signature for gcr.io/redwood/sealed-installer:v2.14.0-rc1-20260321
Key: gcpkms://projects/release/locations/global/keyRings/release/cryptoKeys/installer-sign
SignatureID: sig-20260321-01
```

deploy-bot: deploy window scheduled at 23:00 UTC. Locking pinned manifest to `sealed-installer:v2.14.0-rc1-20260321` for the window. Canary run will begin in 5 minutes prior to window to pre-warm.

mike: I'm going to update the release notes with the rollback snippet and push to the docs site.

jen: who is handling the staging env validation? I can run a quick host install on `canary-2` now.

maria-support: I'll stand by to capture support tickets if QA finds anything during the canary.

jen: quick results: preflight passed, checksum OK, health probes 200 after install. small warning about disk layout on one host but not fatal.

ops_ryan: disk layout warning noted — ops will check if /var/lib/installer needs symlink adjustment. Not blocking canary.

sre_aly: Observability checks look clean: 95th latency steady, no error spikes. Recommend proceed.

mike: Proceeding with canary fanout.

deploy-bot: canary phase started. Targets: canary-1, canary-2, canary-3.

canary-1: install OK, post-install health OK.

canary-2: install OK, minor log warnings about delta ordering but service healthy.

canary-3: install failed on host group B: preflight checksum mismatch on mirror-2.

maria-support: opening support-runbook: mirror-2 reported truncated download. Possibly transport interruption. Ticket created #SUP-5423.

ops_ryan: mirror-2 being replaced; re-triggering installer on canary-3 with alternate mirror. Re-run now.

canary-3: re-run success, health OK.

deploy-bot: canary aggregate: 3/3 healthy. Proceeding to staged rollout per policy: batches of 10% every 15m with auto-hold on 2% error threshold.

sre_aly: monitoring logs for KV cache regressions.

mike: Note for release notes: mention the mirror fallback behavior and recommended support checklist.

pkg_signer: tagging release notes final draft `release-notes/v2.14.0-rc1.md` and pushing sig timestamp. Also rotating `installer-signer-v3` to new TTL after cut (internal ops).

deploy-bot: staged rollout in progress. Next batch in 15m.

maria-support: capturing step-by-step KB for customers: included cosign verification commands and the `--legacy-apply` rollback steps.

jen: small follow-up: after full rollout, we should schedule a quick patch window to flip delta-apply default if telemetry stays stable for 24h.

mike: agreed.

deploy-bot: Rollback trigger conditions: abort and roll back to `v2.13.7` if any of: (a) canary fail >=1 host and not recoverable in 10m, (b) global error rate >2% sustained 10m, (c) preflight checksum failures >1% across hosts. All triggers observed will post an automated rollback plan.

ops_ryan: I'll keep watch. ping me @pager if anything crosses thresholds.

maria-support: KB published. Links: https://internal.docs/redwood/releases/v2.14.0-rc1 and staging signature path.

mike: thanks everyone. leaving ops_ryan and sre_aly to finalize 24h telemetry decision. :thumbsup: 

deploy-bot: deploy complete to all targeted hosts. final status: success. Artifacts pinned: `sealed-installer:v2.14.0-rc1-20260321`.
